intro.text: A demanding Hallandren game, mostly played by the wealthy, in which painted wooden balls are thrown onto a field marked out with ropes and stakes.

description.text: The balls are carved wood around a lead core, painted by role: orange reversal spheres, and deep blue doubling spheres with carved rings. With intricate rules, the game asks for strength, accuracy and strategy alike.
In the Court of Gods both field and balls are oversized to suit the Returned, who usually play from a balcony so they can take in the whole board while servants and scribes keep score.

items.text: Weatherlove, Lifeblesser and Truthcall played every week, using the game as a chance to gossip and scheme. Lightsong joined them several times and kept winning without knowing the rules, which convinced him the game was flawed and let him enjoy irritating them.
